page.title: Meal plans
page.subtitle: Plan the week, then turn it into one shopping list.
page.empty_subtitle: Create a plan to schedule recipes across the week.

add.title: New meal plan
add.description: Name the plan and choose the week it covers.

detail.delete_description: The plan and its entries are removed. Any shopping list you generated from it is kept.

generate.title: Generate a menu
generate.description: Tell us how you eat this week. A menu is proposed straight away — swap anything you don't fancy, adjust portions, then create it.
generate.section_meals_hint: Tap a day to add or skip that meal.
generate.batch_help_2: Each dish is cooked once for two meals; the second is leftovers on a following day.
generate.batch_help_3: Each dish is cooked once for three meals, eaten over the following days.
generate.no_meals_selected: Pick at least one meal to plan in these days.
generate.balance_hint: Varies proteins, vegetables and richer or lighter dishes. Takes a few more seconds.

review.hint: Tick meals to swap several at once, or use the icons on each meal.
review.choose_description: For {{meal}}. Only recipes matching your preferences are listed.
review.open_recipe: Open the recipe in a new tab
review.stale: Your preferences changed since this menu was made.
review.error_hint: Not enough recipes match these preferences. Try fewer dietary restrictions, a longer time limit, or include community recipes.
review.ai_balanced: Balanced by AI: varied proteins, vegetables and lighter dishes.
review.ai_unavailable: AI balancing is unavailable right now; this menu was composed without it.
